subject: Planning: streaming + tool-calling enablement for CareScribe
messages:
From: Emilia Park <emilia.park@lumenhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Connors <sean.connors@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Planning: streaming & tools enablement for CareScribe

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the CareScribe pilot looks promising. We want to move from POC to pilot this quarter but need a concrete enablement runway that covers:

- streaming responses with partial outputs for live transcription UI
- tool-calling patterns (secure HTTP tool calls + retry semantics)
- structured outputs/JSON schema contract for downstream processors
- validation and a lightweight test harness we can run in CI

Can you share a step-by-step plan (owners, milestones, and deliverables) and an example schema we can iterate on? Goal: pilot-ready in ~3 weeks, but we’re flexible if there are technical blockers.

Also include any security or compliance artifacts we should prepare for the pilot run.

Thanks,
Emilia Park
Head of ML Platform | LumenHealth
[emilia.park@lumenhealth.com]

PS: attaching the high-level pilot objectives as a one-pager in our internal tracker (will share link once I have it).

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Emilia Park <emilia.park@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Planning: streaming & tools enablement for CareScribe

Emilia — thanks for the clear ask. High-level plan below; attaching a mutual action plan (MAP_LumenHealth_Q1-2027.xlsx) and a starter JSON schema (sample_schema_v1.json) for the structured output contract.

High-level runway (proposal)
1) Day 0–2: kickoff working session, confirm integration points and auth model for tool-calls (we support signed short-lived tokens and mTLS). Owner: Connor.
2) Day 3–7: schema iteration + test harness (sample_schema_v1.json). Owner: Marissa.
3) Day 8–14: streaming integration + partial-output validation in staging; implement prefix/KV caching settings. Owner: Connor.
4) Day 15–21: pilot bake and runbook, golden prompt set, SLA smoke tests; cross-team signoff. Owner: Neha + Marissa.

Open/questions for your team
- Which tool-call surfaces need to be proxied by Redwood vs. called from your environment?
- Any constraints on outbound IPs or network egress?
- Who will own schema regression signoff on your side?

Attachments: MAP_LumenHealth_Q1-2027.xlsx (action matrix), sample_schema_v1.json (structured output contract)

If that runway looks OK I’ll book a 90-min kickoff slot for tomorrow or Thursday.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
[Attachment: MAP_LumenHealth_Q1-2027.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: sample_schema_v1.json (JSON)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emilia Park <emilia.park@lumenhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Planning: streaming & tools enablement for CareScribe

On Tue, Feb 9, 2027 at 11:03 AM Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com> wrote:
> Emilia — thanks for the clear ask. High-level plan below; attaching a mutual action plan...

Folks — I populated the MAP with owners and tentative dates. Quick notes I added to the sheet:
- Connor: will own the streaming test harness and provide a minimal containerized example that calls Redwood’s streaming endpoint and emits partial JSON shards.
- Marissa (me): will coordinate schema reviews and provide a validation script (node + pytest examples) that you can run in CI.
- Priyom: will instrument the rollout checklist and preflight checks for token rotation and caching profiles.

I also added a column for acceptance criteria per milestone (smoke test pass rate, median token latency, schema validation pass).

Next steps: Neha / Connor please propose kickoff slots (we prefer midday PDT). Emilia / Sean — once you confirm the kickoff, we’ll share the Drive folder and a short pre-read (the MAP + sample schema).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[Attachment: MAP_LumenHealth_Q1-2027.xlsx]

From: Sean Connors <sean.connors@lumenhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Emilia Park <emilia.park@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 14:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Planning: streaming & tools enablement for CareScribe

Thanks team — this looks good. A couple of clarifications from our engineering side:

- Tool-calling patterns: we will prefer that Redwood calls a short-lived internal webhook (so your runtime issues a signed callback token). We can also host the tool in our VPC if needed.
- Structured outputs: we will require a JSON Schema + a small regression harness that validates both top-level shape and specific field enums.
- Data plane constraints: no external PHI storage outside our cloud account — for the pilot we will use a tokenized flow where Redwood never persists raw transcripts.

We can confirm the kickoff for Wed 2027-02-10 10:00 AM PDT. Please share the pre-read and samples beforehand.

Best,
Sean Connors
Engineering Lead, Integrations | LumenHealth
sean.connors@lumenhealth.com

Thanks — Wed 10:00 AM PDT works for us. We appreciate the clear agenda. Two small asks before kick-off:

1) Please include a short README for the sample_schema_v1.json that documents required vs optional fields and an example valid payload (we’ll paste that into our CI).
2) If you have a short note on how Redwood handles partial-output consistency (e.g., whether the KV cache can be warmed per session) that would be helpful for our SREs.

I’ll send the calendar acceptance and drop the pilot objectives doc in the Drive. See you tomorrow.
